name: Robot Framework Fundamentals: The Stranded Protocol
description: You are PROTO-7, newly activated and stranded on planet Syntax-IV. MENTOR-9 will guide you through Robot Framework fundamentals as you repair the ship's diagnostic systems and escape.

story.title: The Stranded Protocol
story.premise: Two robots crash-land on planet Syntax-IV. The ship's diagnostic system is damaged. The only way to repair it is to write Robot Framework test suites that check each ship component.

characters.name: PROTO-7
characters.description: A test automation robot, recently activated, eager but inexperienced

characters.name: MENTOR-9
characters.description: Senior diagnostic robot, your ship companion, patient teacher

story.arc: Wake up → Learn basics → Check systems → Build logic → Organize diagnostics → Escape the planet

learningObjectives: Understand Robot Framework's whitespace-based syntax and formatting rules
Master test case and keyword structure with proper indentation
Implement control flow (IF/ELSE, FOR, WHILE, TRY/EXCEPT)
Create custom keywords and organize code with resource files
Work with BuiltIn library and standard libraries (Collections, String, DateTime)
Apply test organization patterns (setup/teardown, tags, templates)
Build complete, maintainable test suites following best practices
